mutants.description: OVP is recorded only in S_RUN, on the assumption that overvoltage can only occur once the output is regulated, so an OVP overshoot during soft start is not recorded
mutants.reason: An analog OVP trip (latch_state high, latch_assert low) during S_SS leaves fault_reg[4] clear. episode_start still fires on ovp, so fault_time is latched while fault_reg reads empty.

mutants.description: The OVP and LATCH_ASSERT cause bits are laid out in swapped positions, with the CPLD's measured trip misremembered as outranking the inferred OVP
mutants.reason: An analog OVP trip while running sets fault_reg bit 3 (10000 expected, 01000 read), and a latch_assert captured while running sets bit 4, so the host reads the wrong cause.

mutants.description: OVP is inferred with the two latch signals confused: CPLD trip asserted while the SCR readback is still clear, instead of readback set without a CPLD trip
mutants.reason: An analog OVP trip while running (latch_state high, latch_assert low) no longer sets fault_reg[4] or opens an episode. A CPLD trip seen while running before the debounced readback follows is wrongly recorded as OVP.
